correctness.rationale: Triangulate the symmetrized regular simplex into n binomial(n-1,floor((n-1)/2)) simplicial cones, each intrinsic volume 1/(sqrt(n)(n-1)!). A uniform d-simplex Dirichlet moment yields radial second moment per conical cell; permutation invariance forces covariance lambda I on H_n with claimed odd/even formulas. Compare isotropic constants using exact central binomial Wallis products p_m, q_m; finitely many borderline inequalities exact-rational and infinite tails via 2/pi and strict exponential bounds. Independently checked exact rational inequalities m<=25 and independently reconstructed convex hull volume/second moments at n=3,4,5; none of the finite checks alone establish all dimensions. Limit from log Wallis product and Stirling.
residual_risks: Finite examples corroborate exact proof; no claim of formal Lean proof, human expert validation, or exhaustive universal numerical verification.
